evidence.summary: Inactive SequenceCopy source lanes are clamped before the load; the external-view large-offset regression passes on all five executable backends.
The 5-live control and former 13-live trigger return on research bytecode, portable WASM, C11, LLVM, and Cranelift.
The uncapped 1/5/64 chunk matrix returned 6 cases and hit named MNCS_RSRC_EXHAUSTED on 9 larger C11/LLVM/Cranelift cases; the WASM matrix passed.

reproduction.instructions: Run mncs-web repro/feed-chunk-trap.py on all five executable backends, then run the uncapped test_fragmentation.py chunk cases; the former 13-live trigger passes, while larger native chunk cases return MNCS_RSRC_EXHAUSTED.

summary: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED: the eager inactive-lane source-address failure is fixed and the former 13-live trigger returns on all five backends; C11, LLVM, and Cranelift still exhaust their bounded native arena on larger 37+ live-chunk cases.

workaround.description: Explicit per-backend live-chunk ceilings remain for C11, LLVM, and Cranelift; portable WASM no longer needs the former 12-live ceiling.
